nurse.text: Ah, a traveller. Cup of tea? It's the same as healing, but with biscuits.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Let me just have a look at that team of yours.
There. Good as new and smelling faintly of coconut.
The Ark terminal's just here. Mind the cable.

else.text: Right you are. Shout if anyone needs a plaster.
